notes: IMPORTANT CAVEAT: AirBox is fundamentally broadcast playout-automation SOFTWARE (confirmed on playboxtechnology.com/airbox-1 and the official AirBox product sheet), not a device with a fixed, manufacturer-published physical I/O spec. It runs on a PC/server and uses third-party capture/output cards (Blackmagic DeckLink, AJA Corvid, etc.) or optional AJA/Blackmagic SDI I/O selected per installation. PlayBox Technology also sold a bundled rackmount hardware appliance running AirBox — documented as the "PlayBox SD/HD Server System" / "Channel in a Box" — whose Hardware Maintenance Manual (manualslib.com host of the PDF) is the only source found with concrete physical-connector detail, so the port list above reflects that hardware bundle's documented back panel rather than a spec sheet titled "AirBox." Exact SDI I/O card count/configuration is build-to-order and "may vary slightly" per the manual's own wording — the 2-in/2-out SDI figures are for one representative I/O card; multi-card configurations add more identical SDI pairs. Could not obtain the manual's rear-panel diagram/table pages directly (PDF text extraction failed; relied on an AI-summarized excerpt of a third-party manual host), so treat exact port counts and the inferred connector types (AES/EBU as BNC, GPI as HD-15/VGA-shaped, power as IEC) as unverified. The newer "AirBox Neo" hardware line adds NDI, UHD/HD/SD SDI, and AJA/Blackmagic card options per pbteu.com/playboxneo.com, but no detailed rear-panel connector spec could be confirmed for it either. Given all this, treat this as a best-effort composite reconstruction, not an authoritative datasheet — recommend contacting PlayBox Technology/PBT directly for a verified spec sheet if precise port counts are needed. Rack unit height could not be confirmed and was omitted.

ports.name: AES/EBU Audio In
ports.note: 2-channel unbalanced AES/EBU digital audio; manual specifies 'unbalanced' which implies 75-ohm BNC rather than XLR AES3

ports.name: GPI I/O
ports.note: HD-15 (DE-15) breakout for optocoupled GPI inputs and relay GPI outputs — not a video port; mapped to VGA/HD-15 connector shape since no GPI-specific id exists

ports.name: LAN 1
ports.note: Gigabit support inferred from documented LED behavior (amber = 1Gbps), not an explicit spec statement

ports.name: AC Power In
ports.note: Connector type inferred from typical rackmount server PSU design; not explicitly confirmed in the source excerpts obtained
